sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt: Dividend Policy The Company does not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future. If the Company incurs indebtedness in the future to fund its future growth, its ability to pay dividends may be further restricted by the terms of such indebtedness. DETERMINATION OF OFFERING PRICE The selling securityholders will offer and sell the shares covered by this prospectus at a fixed price of $0.085 per share for the duration of this offering, until such time as our Common Stock is quoted on the OTCQB tier of OTC Markets or another established trading market, at which time the shares may be sold at prevailing market prices, at prices related to prevailing market prices or at privately negotiated prices.
